title: hieracium pilosella subsp. sedunorum
intro: Hieracium pilosella subsp. sedunorum, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pilosella subsp. sedunorum include its ability to stimulate digestion and reduce symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
